source.extraction_predicate: exact ST_X/ST_Y point position within the unrounded accepted MI or WI tract envelope, with bbox overlap or null-bbox prefilter
source.bbox_qa: bbox is optional; all-four-null is retained under exact geometry filtering, partial-null fails, and a present finite bbox must contain the point
source.license_summary: Places source records are distributed under CDLA Permissive 2.0, Apache 2.0, or CC0 according to provider; this experimental aggregate retains no provider field or source record.

geography.point_assignment: actual Overture point geometry against accepted 2024 TIGER tract polygons in source CRS; covers first, then unique strict contains; unresolved boundary or outside-support places excluded with QA accounting
geography.exploratory_datum_semantics: WGS84 point longitude/latitude are treated as numerically coordinate-equivalent to NAD83 for this experimental tract overlay; no datum shift is introduced, accepted tract geometry is unchanged, and unresolved shared-boundary cases are excluded
geography.five_mile_semantics: sum frozen tract-local components over the accepted state-isolated five-mile tract membership; containing tract forced present

quality_status_identity_rules.confidence_rule: confidence is non-null and strictly greater than 0.7
quality_status_identity_rules.confidence_reason: target-blind precision-oriented threshold used in Overture's public place-density tutorial; the score is treated only as a relative existence-quality filter and not as a calibrated probability
quality_status_identity_rules.permanently_closed_confidence_mismatch_r: exclude every permanently_closed place regardless of confidence and report nonzero-confidence inconsistency before target access
quality_status_identity_rules.release_anomaly_semantics: nonzero confidence on known permanently_closed rows is an observed pinned-release/schema anomaly; operating status controls exclusion and confidence is not normalized
quality_status_identity_rules.identity_rule: one released row per unique Overture GERS place id
quality_status_identity_rules.duplicate_rule: duplicate or non-monotonic id in the canonical extract fails closed; no name, brand, provider, coordinate, or fuzzy deduplication

taxonomy_rules.invalid_or_mismatched_primary_hierarchy_: exclude from every model feature and report before target access; do not repair from alternates or deprecated fields
